entries.41f1900b423ba278: As its management philosophy, it sets "aiming, through collaboration with things and matters around the world, to eliminate people's hassle, and for the many encounters and time and other things created thereby to enrich society." In the Application Service Business, to solve issues of labor shortages and business efficiency at accommodation facilities, it states that it will develop systems and collaboration with sales channels that lead to business efficiency and improved convenience and new functions, make it a chosen product, and, with company-wide unified support, strive for further spread of "TEMAIRAZU." In the Internet Media Business, it states that it will seek to increase net sales by making it a service used by even more people through search engine optimization, improvement of the user interface, enhancement of content, and addition of categories. In the next fiscal year as well, it expects to make investment in human resources, development investment for functional enhancement, and system investment including security measures.
